integrity: The 2013 generalized-Rayleigh source was checked for the exact family, positive-integer exponent, publication date, and primary mathematical classification. A complete later same-family preprint was inspected through the exact equations, global phase portraits, limit-cycle uniqueness theorem, and classification; full-document searches found no moment, average, invariant, or covariance formulation. A complete public classical-Rayleigh study was inspected through the exact planar equations, fixed-point analysis, Melnikov calculation, and limit-cycle stability, with no matching stationary-statistical terminology. Published semantic searches covered conditional expectation, nonlinear regression, power moments, root-mean-square velocity, covariance, and threshold excursions. The conditional laws, moment shell, strict endpoints, threshold excursion, and orthogonal variance decomposition were independently reconstructed and replayed algebraically with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes \(a\ne0\); at \(a=0\) the linear harmonic center does not satisfy the same power-moment locking.
The result constrains conditional means and selected moments rather than determining the full invariant distribution or limit-cycle period.
The dimensionless root-mean-square ceiling is tied to the standard generalized-Rayleigh normalization.
The 2013 generalized-family primary article was checked through its bibliographic record and abstract rather than a complete local full-text copy.

The scalar energy balance is short enough that it may have appeared implicitly; the originality claim concerns the combined fiber law, variance defect, strict ceiling, and threshold-excursion structure.
title: Fiberwise velocity law and exact pumping–damping shell in the generalized Rayleigh oscillator
